observations.trace: The viewer picks an accepted-species PlantCaptureAnchor root and the observer selects PlantLodInstance entities whose transform translation is within squared distance 1e-8 of that root. Each retained row includes its species, LOD, per-camera VisibleEntities membership, native visibility-range result and CPU mesh index count. The observer has no explicit per-site or scene identity in this query.
observations.counterevidence: For one production scene, placements makes at most one site per 2m grid cell; each axis jitter lies from0.15 through0.85 cell units, because the deterministic inclusive unit sample is defined between0 and1. In exact real arithmetic, adjacent cell positions are separated by at least (1+0.15−0.85)×2=0.6m in a differing axis, far beyond the 0.0001m observer radius. Each site spawns its three deliberately co-located LOD tiers and one anchor. This rules out a simple arbitrary same-scene duplicate-site assumption under that ideal bound, not all floating-point behavior.
observations.remaining: Floating-point rounding at admitted world-coordinate limits, any extra plant producer or simultaneous scene population, actual lifecycle/schedule, entity membership and metric policy remain open. The ordinary viewer setup queues one terrain entity; clear_scene_entities explicitly removes GroundScatterLayer entities when called, except regional-map owners. No scene, duplicate, draw or cleanup was run.

observations.trace: CapturedObstacles::spawn collects every SupportedObstacle and required terrain height before spawning any native obstacle. Tree focus uses the same half-trunk-height constant as the generated centre and view-camera root reconstruction.
